purpose: Extract a reusable single-glyph analysis grammar for TC001 from repeated transmitted Wang-form examples without treating Huairen inscription adjacency as Wang Xizhi phrase flow.
sourceCautions: Huairen assembled the inscription from collected Wang-form sources; neighboring inscription characters are locator context only.
Stone carving and rubbing transmission may alter edge, thickness and micro-turn appearance.
Do not infer original ink pressure, inter-character spacing, entry from the previous glyph, exit into the next glyph, or phrase rhythm from this source.

Some scholarship discusses possible constructed or composite glyphs in the compilation; every unusual form therefore remains provenance-sensitive rather than automatically canonical Wang autograph evidence.

comparisonProtocol.rule: Only a feature recurring across defensible instances may be promoted toward a stable skeleton. A feature visible in one instance remains a variant or hypothesis.
